αἰγύπτοιο: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; also the river Nile, called by the same name; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’
βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ‘good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg.
διιπετέος: διιπετής — fallen from the sky, sky-fed (Διός + πίπτω); adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., standing epithet of a great river
διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’
εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα ’broad backs’ (ἐπ’ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης ’over the broad back of the sea’) · also masc. acc. sg., epic by-form of εὐρύν, agreeing with a masc. noun (θαλάσσης εὐρέα κόλπον ’the sea’s broad bosom’)
εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
εὐρύμαχος: Εὐρύμαχος — Eurymachus, a leading suitor, son of Polybus; masc. nom. sg.
ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; adj., masc. acc. sg.
ζωὸς: ζωός — alive, living; masc. nom. sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
θείου: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg.
θεοειδής: θεοειδής — godlike in form (θεός + εἶδος); masc. nom. sg.
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
καθήμενος: κάθημαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’)
κατεκλάσθη: κατακλάω — break down, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was broken down’ (of the heart)
κατερύκεται: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is held back’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κειμήλιον: κειμήλιον — a treasure, thing laid up or stored (from κεῖμαι); nom. sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’
κιόντι: κίω — go, walk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as (I) went’
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κληῖσι: κληΐς — thole-pin, oarlock (also ’key, bolt’ elsewhere); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι
κοιμήθημεν: κοιμάω — put to sleep; pass. lie down to rest; aor. pass. 1 pl.: ’we lay down to sleep’
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable form of κριθή); neut. acc. sg.
κυμαίνοντα: κυμαίνω — swell, billow (of the sea, from κῦμα ’wave’); pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον: ’billowing, surging’
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μεγάροιο: μέγαρον — hall; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, remembering’
μενέλαε: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta; masc. voc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’
μᾶλλον: μάλα — very, much; comparative adv. μᾶλλον: ’more, rather, the more’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’
νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
νημερτής: νημερτής — unerring, infallible, truthful (νη- + ἁμαρτάνω); adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Proteus (γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής)
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νῆες
νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl. νῶτα, poetic image ’the broad back(s) of the sea’
ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Menelaus
οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.

οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
οἴχετ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. 3 sg., elided (οἴχετ’ = οἴχεται), perfect sense: ’is gone’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐκί: οὐ — not; emphatic form οὐκί: ’not’ (ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’)
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’)
πένοντο: πένομαι — labor at, be busy with, toil; impf. 3 pl.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πείρατα: πεῖραρ — end, limit, the means to an end; neut. nom./acc. pl. (πείρατα τέχνης ’the ends, the completion, of a craft’)
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)

ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc.
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
πόρφυρε: πορφύρω — heave, seethe, churn (properly of the sea darkening/heaving); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, applied metaphorically to a troubled heart
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σοῖσιν: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τάφου: Τάφος — Taphos, home island of Mentes and the Taphians; masc. gen. sg.
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε)
τέρπομαι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. pres. 1 sg.: ’I delight (my heart)’
τέρποντο: τέρπομαι — take pleasure, enjoy oneself; impf. 3 pl.
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεληέσσας: τεληείς — complete, fulfilling, perfect (of sacrifice, from τέλος); adj., fem. acc. pl.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιγὰρ: τοιγάρ — well then, accordingly; particle introducing a response to a request
τοκήων: τοκεύς — parent, begetter; masc. gen. pl.
τούτους: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. pl.
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg.
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; acc. sg.
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’
υἱέ: υἱός — son; masc. voc. sg. (Ἀτρέος υἱέ ’son of Atreus’)
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg.
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρονίοιο: Φρόνιος — Phronius, father of Noemon; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χείλεα: χεῖλος — lip, rim, brim; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted
χρυσῷ: χρυσός — gold; masc. dat. sg.: ’with gold’
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
ψαμάθοισι: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθάνατοι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. pl.: ’the immortals’
ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
ἀμβροσίη: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, immortal; adj., fem. nom. sg., standing epithet of night
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνειρόμενος: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’asking’
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπους: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; acc. pl.
ἀντίνο: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀντίνο’ = Ἀντίνοε)
ἀντίνοος: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, son of Eupeithes, a leading suitor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’)
ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
ἀσκελὲς: ἀσκελής — unyielding, stubborn; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially
ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’grieved (though I am)’
ἁλὶ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
ἄγαλμα: ἄγαλμα — a thing that delights, ornament, offering for a god; neut. acc. sg.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg.
ἄγων: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’leading’
ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. sg.
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl., masc. nom. pl.
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἅλιος: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. nom. sg., part of the standing epithet γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής ’the old man of the sea’ (of Proteus)
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδύσετο: δύω/δύνω — enter, sink into, plunge; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic sigmatic (ἐδύσετο, = Attic ἔδυ): ’she plunged (in)’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπήρετμοι: ἐπήρετμος — at the oar, seated ready to row; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; here as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἐπί ... ἤλυθεν = ἐπῆλθεν ’came on, came upon’); accented ἐπί before the following enclitic τε
ἐπίμεινον: ἐπιμένω — wait, stay on, remain; aor. imper. 2 sg.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’of (those) being’ (θεῶν αἰὲν ἐόντων ’of the gods who are forever’)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑζόμενοι: ἕζομαι — sit down; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’seated’
ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, a great sacrifice (orig. of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
ἑνδεκάτη: ἑνδέκατος — eleventh; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
ἑξῆς: ἑξῆς — in order, one after another; adv. (by-form of ἑξείης)
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’)
ἔρεξα: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 sg.
ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤθελ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἤθελ’ = ἤθελε): ’he wished’
ἤια: ἤια — provisions for a journey; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (subject): ’our stores’ · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, grazed by horses; adj., neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’used to go, come’ · also as a simple narrative past, ’went’ (μνηστῆρες … ἴσαν ’the suitors went’), not necessarily iterative
ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid.: ’you may reach’
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε)
ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
ὀρέστης: Ὀρέστης — Orestes, son of Agamemnon who avenged him; nom. sg.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁπλισάμεσθ: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided ὁπλισάμεσθ’ (= ὁπλισάμεσθα): ’we got (supper) ready’
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ὅσσ’ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται ’as many creatures as come to be upon earth’
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic neut. nom./acc. sg. ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’)
ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
